iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 77. CRITICAL: IAEA DG Grossi urges 'very detailed' verification in any deal. Iran rules out enrichment restrictions - nuclear chief says no scenario where Tehran gives up enriching uranium. US demands 20-yr freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. IAEA locked out 8+ months, cannot verify stockpile. Experts: stockpile could yield up to 10 bombs. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. Probability 30%. Stable.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 77. CRITICAL: Trump EXTENDED ceasefire but naval blockade remains. Iran says no delegation has traveled to Pakistan 'so far' for talks. FM says Iran won't negotiate under threat. US issued new 'Economic Fury' sanctions on 14 individuals/companies. US seized Iranian cargo ship; Iran demands crew release. IRGC fired on commercial vessels in Hormuz. State media warns of 'regret-inducing response.' Iran preparing to possibly resume war. Oil volatile, Brent ~$88-101. Pakistan tense capital awaits talks. Vance trip in holding pattern. Probability 45%. Stable.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 6 of 10-day ceasefire. Hezbollah fired rockets/drones into northern Israel Apr 21, accusing IDF of violations. Mostly holding. Expires Apr 26. Second round ambassador-level talks in Washington Apr 23. Israel holds 10km buffer. Deal does NOT require Hezbollah disarmament. 2,196 killed in Lebanon. Probability 18%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Hosting 2026 NATO Summit Jul 7-8 in Ankara. Pushing for larger role in European defense, warning EU against excluding Turkey. FM Fidan urges NATO to reset US ties. Probability 4%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: ELEVATED: Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports. IRGC fired on Indian-flagged tankers Jag Arnav and Sanmar Herald. India strongly condemned Hormuz conflict as 'unacceptable.' CFR warns India-Pakistan conflict likely in 2026. Probability 8%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 77. ELEVATED/CRITICAL: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting imminent - would allow transport/possession on Finnish soil. First F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: 'will force countermeasures.' Russia reinforcing strategic/nuclear assets near Finnish border. Lavrov at Antalya: NATO 'aggressive bloc.' Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Probability 32%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US intelligence confirmed China preparing MANPADS/air defense shipment to Iran. Chinese officials deny. Analysts: may be Trump-Xi summit bargaining chip re Taiwan. Xi met Taiwan opposition leader Cheng Li-wun. China says war at 'critical stage of transition' and calls for further negotiations. China fully supports Pakistan mediation. Probability 38%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 75. RISING: Launched 5 tactical ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 - 7th test of 2026, 4th in April. Kim 'great satisfaction' over Hwasong-11 variant. Also tested cruise/anti-ship missiles from destroyer Choe Hyon. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Probability 18%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1179+. Russia launched 659 drones + 44 missiles pre-truce, 16+ killed. Russia-Ukraine agreed to Orthodox Easter truce Apr 12 but both accuse violations. Kremlin: won't extend unless Kyiv accepts terms. Ukraine crippling Russian oil infrastructure - 40% export capacity disabled. Lavrov: patience 'not unlimited.' Probability 35%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated Urumqi talks ongoing since Apr 1. Both agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan mortars killed Afghan civilians during talks. No formal agreement yet. Probability 5%. Stable.
